# The Bushwick Nightcrawlers

> An interactive sound piece: a hand-drawn map of Myrtle-Broadway in Bushwick, Brooklyn, where rats review the venues in Yelp form, voiced in real rat calls.

A sound piece scored for the corner of Myrtle and Broadway at night, narrated as Yelp reviews by the rats who live there. Click any pin on the map to read a review and hear it spoken in rat vocalizations, some slowed from ultrasound into human hearing range.

Concept, design and sonification by Shoro Roy; map and pin art by Madhura Redij. Real Bushwick venue names are used. Reviews and rat personae are fictional.

## Pages

- [The map](https://bushwick.shoro.space/): the piece itself. Requires JavaScript and sound.
- [About](https://bushwick.shoro.space/about.html): why The Bushwick Nightcrawlers exists, how its rat voices were made, some slowed from ultrasound into human hearing, and full credits and sources.

- [Scientists Map the Nightlife and Communication of NYC Rats (Scientific American, 2025)](https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/scientists-map-nightlife-and-communication-of-nyc-rats-to-help-urban/): the inspiration.
